However questions include v19 RTX 50 Super launch. It may be important for product timeline and margins. Could label core? Need independent. Candidate e: Singapore smuggling probe, charges, servers may contain Nvidia chips. Relevant to export controls/chip diversion risk, but not concrete financial impact; regulatory risk. Could be colour? Candidate f: 25 tech companies letter urging no premature restrictions on open-weight AI models. Exact text from article. Relevant to policy/regulatory environment, AI model restrictions. It may affect NVDA? They are signatory. Could be core? It indicates coalition and policy stance, but not financial. Could be colour. Candidate g: Trump admin would look into Chinese IP theft and ability to sanction. Policy risk, relevant to China export controls; core or colour? Candidate h: White House advisor says Moonshot developed Kimi K3 by distilling Anthropic tech. This is allegation/claim, relevant to policy debate, perhaps not direct NVDA. Colour. Candidate i: hyperscaler spending expected top $1T in 2027 after projected $650B in 2026 (management forecast? "During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending..." Actually article says management forecast? "During its last quarterly conference call, management forecast that it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion..." likely Nvidia management? It is a key demand forecast relevant to v4/v5. Core? likely core, as it underpins revenue growth. Candidate a also analyst revenue growth forecast. Candidate b EPS forecast. Candidate c memory shortage. Candidate d AMD throughput claims. Candidate e smuggling. Candidate f letter. Candidate g admin China IP. Candidate h distillation allegation. Candidate i hyperscaler capex forecast.

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026-07-06 文章援引华尔街分析师预期：NVIDIA 年内剩余时间营收增长约82%，2027年增速约41%。这是分析师预测，非公司指引，且未给出绝对营收金额。
items.quote: For the rest of this year, they expect 82% growth. For 2027, that figure rises to 41%.
items.why: 可用于辅助判断FY2027营收方向，但仅为分析师增速预测且无绝对值，不足以单独改变投资看法。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026-07-06 文章称分析师平均预计NVIDIA FY2028（截至2028年1月）EPS为12.76美元；作者据此用25倍PE推导约319美元目标价。这是远期共识预测和估值假设。
items.quote: For fiscal 2028, ending January 2028, the average analyst projects $12.76 in earnings per share.
items.why: 与FY2027利润/营收问题并非直接对应，属估值辅助信息；保留可跟踪盈利预期，但不构成核心驱动。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 2026-07-18 文章引述SK hynix判断：2027年将是内存短缺“最糟糕的一年”，短缺将持续到2030年。这强化GDDR7/HBM等内存成本与供应约束，可能推高GPU和AI系统BOM并影响RTX 50 Super上市与毛利率。
items.quote: 2027 is set to be the “worst year” for the memory shortage and said that the crunch will last until 2030.
items.why: 关键供应链和成本风险，直接关系到产品发布节奏、定价和利润率，具备改变投资看法的潜力。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026-07-22 BofA报告转述AMD自身估算：在100kW部署模型中，EPYC 9965 Turin的机架级吞吐约为NVIDIA Vera基线的2.4倍，下一代EPYC 6 Venice预计将优势扩大至约3.3倍。这是竞争对手的基准主张，而非独立基准。
items.quote: AMD estimates its EPYC 9965 (Turin) chip delivers approximately 2.4x the rack-level throughput of NVIDIA's Vera baseline in a modeled 100kW deployment, with the next-generation EPYC 6 (Venice) projected to extend that advantage to roughly 3.3x total throughput, according to BofA's characterization of AMD's own estimates.
items.why: 提供NVIDIA服务器CPU竞争基准，但属AMD自估且依赖模型假设，适合作为辅助竞争背景而非核心事实。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026-07-02 新加坡警方调查涉嫌违反美国出口管制的NVIDIA芯片转运案，查封约S$5500万豪宅并追加欺诈/洗钱指控；涉案服务器可能含先进NVIDIA AI芯片，拟由新加坡运往马来西亚，有报道猜测最终目的地为中国，但尚未确认。
items.quote: servers in question, which may have contained advanced Nvidia AI chips
items.why: 这是出口管制执法风险信号，但未直接指向NVIDIA责任或财务影响，属辅助信息。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 2026-07-24 包括NVIDIA、Microsoft、Meta、Palantir在内的25家科技公司联署公开信，呼吁政策制定者避免对开放权重AI模型实施“过早限制”，称可能扼杀竞争或把创新推向海外。这是涉及潜在美国对华开放模型限制的行业政策立场事件。
items.quote: released a letter Friday urging policymakers to avoid "premature restrictions" on open-weight artificial intelligence models
items.why: 与多项中国开放权重模型限制问题直接相关，且NVIDIA是联署方，可能影响监管风险判断，值得核心记录。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026-07-24 文章称美国财政部长Scott Bessent周二对CNBC表示，特朗普政府将调查中国公司是否窃取美国知识产权，并称政府“有能力因此制裁它们”。这是官员表态，尚未形成具体规则。
items.quote: the Trump administration would look into whether Chinese companies were stealing American intellectual property
items.why: 反映对华AI和知识产权制裁风险，但为调查意向而非落地政策，作为政策背景保留。

items.label: colour
items.meaning: 2026-07-24 白宫顾问Michael Kratsios称，中国月之暗面（Moonshot AI）通过蒸馏Anthropic技术开发了Kimi K3；文章同时提到合法蒸馏有价值，但大规模隐蔽工业蒸馏不可接受。这属官员指控。
items.quote: China's Moonshot AI developed its Kimi K3 model by distilling Anthropic's technology
items.why: 为开放权重模型限制辩论提供政策理由，但仅为指控和背景，不直接改变NVIDIA财务判断。

items.label: core
items.meaning: 2026-07-06 文章称NVIDIA管理层在最近季度电话会预测：超大规模云厂商支出2026年约6500亿美元，2027年将超过1万亿美元。这是需求端关键预测，支撑其营收增长逻辑。
items.quote: it expects hyperscaler spending to top $1 trillion in 2027 after reaching a projected $650 billion in 2026
items.why: 直接关联AI资本开支问题及NVIDIA数据中心需求，是核心需求前瞻信号。
